definitions.explanation: A person who creates art, particularly in the fine arts (painting, sculpture, music, literature). Implies serious artistic pursuit rather than casual creativity.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{芸術家|げいじゅつか}だ。
{若|わか}い{芸術家|げいじゅつか}を{支援|しえん}する{制度|せいど}がある。
examples.english: There is a system to support young artists.

examples.japanese: {芸術家|げいじゅつか}にとって{自由|じゆう}な{発想|はっそう}は{何|なに}よりも{大切|たいせつ}だと{彼|かれ}は{語|かた}った。
examples.english: He said that for an artist, free creative thinking is more important than anything else.

notes:
A compound of {芸術|げいじゅつ} (art, fine arts) and {家|か} (professional, -ist). Refers to someone who seriously practices the arts as a calling.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アーティスト is the loanword equivalent, used more broadly and casually
- {画家|がか} specifically means painter
- {彫刻家|ちょうこくか} specifically means sculptor
- {音楽家|おんがくか} specifically means musician
- {芸術家|げいじゅつか} is the broad umbrella term covering all art forms

Sometimes used figuratively to describe someone with artistic temperament or eccentricity: {芸術家|げいじゅつか}{肌|はだ} (having the temperament of an artist).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芸術家|げいじゅつか}{肌|はだ} (artistic temperament)
- {現代|げんだい}{芸術家|げいじゅつか} (contemporary artist)
- {芸術家|げいじゅつか}を{目指|めざ}す (to aspire to be an artist)
